title: Asymmetric H-plane step read from an STL file: WR-90 narrowing to 16 mm against one wall
source: The geometry of the hplane-step-offset case, given as a 20-triangle ASCII STL surface (step.stl, millimetres) instead of waveguide sections: mode matching of TE_m0 modes at the step (A. Wexler, IEEE Trans. MTT 15(9):508–517, 1967), converged with 640 modes; power waves between ports of different aperture

quantities.reason: the surface's six faces found by the angle between triangles, the ports on its end planes recognised as rectangles, meshed with uniform unstructured tetrahedra of 3 mm (no grading at the step's re-entrant edge): +2.2e-3
a small reflection: 3e-3 of complex error is about 1.4° of its phase (+1.8° measured)
|S21|² = 1 − |S11|² to rounding, so it errs by |S11| δ|S11|
